text:
7.4.3.6.2.4 Binary Manifest
The implementation of the Dem High Proxy may require some basic infrastructure
from the Dem Low Proxy in order to be operational. Such generic infrastructure ser-
vices can be linked between Application Software Cluster and Host Soft-
ware Cluster by means of a Dem base socket.
[SWS_SwCluC_02744]
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements: SRS_SwCluC_00209, SRS_SwCluC_00212
⌈The Dem High Proxy shall create for each SwCluCDemProxyBaseSocket a re-
quired resource entry in the Binary Manifest.⌋
[SWS_SwCluC_02745]
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements: SRS_SwCluC_00209, SRS_SwCluC_00212
⌈The Dem High Proxy shall create for each diagnostic event proxy - config-
ured via SwCluCDemProxyDiagnosticEvent container - a required resource entry
in the Binary Manifest.⌋
